realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Judge
primary.description: Weighs fairness deliberately; authority must be earned, not assumed.
primary.guiding_promise: I hold the scale steady, even when the verdict costs me.
primary.shadow_description: Hides behind the letter of the rule to avoid the harder, human work of mercy.

secondary.label: Visionary
secondary.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
secondary.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

wheel.central_question: Should justice be weighed case by case, or upheld as an unbending line?

growth.label: Visionary
growth.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
growth.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
growth.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

other_ally.label: Bureaucrat
other_ally.description: Finds safety and fairness in process, dreads chaos.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I build the structures that protect what matters from chaos.
other_ally.shadow_description: Clings to the process long after it stops serving the people it was built to protect.

quarter.label: Diplomat
quarter.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
quarter.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
quarter.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

opposite.label: Warden
opposite.description: Guards boundaries that others don't even know exist; constant, thankless watch.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will hold this line, long after everyone else has forgotten why it matters.
opposite.shadow_description: Stands watch so long they start seeing threats at a threshold nothing is actually crossing.

realmmate.label: Democrat
realmmate.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
